result.summary: Found 1 major issue: character encoding/rendering problem in restaurant delivery time information.

issues.description: The delivery time for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' displays as '25-3️⃣0️⃣delivery' with emoji keycap characters instead of regular numbers. It should read '25-30 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the character encoding or data formatting to ensure numbers are displayed as standard numerals rather than emoji characters. Check the backend data source for encoding issues.
